components.name: scripts/sbom.js
components.description: SUDS SBOM generator (Node built-ins and git only)

component.name: suds
component.description: SUD Navigator Services Tracker — operations for harm-reduction and prevention programmes: outreach, visits, naloxone and supplies, referrals and grant reporting, with HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 privacy

properties.name: suds:timestamp-is
properties.value: the date of the 1.21.0 section of CHANGELOG.md (the version stamp's date; a release's date is its tag's)

properties.name: suds:scopes
properties.value: required = shipped and used at run time; optional = one deployment shape only; excluded = development, build, test or CI tooling that never ships

components.name: node
components.description: Node.js runtime. The office server needs nothing else: no npm package is installed to run it. The operator supplies and patches Node; this is the release CI and the release workflow test on.

externalReferences.comment: The hash is of this file, pinned in .github/workflows/ci.yml

properties.name: suds:builtins-used-by-server
properties.value: node:async_hooks, node:child_process, node:crypto, node:dgram, node:dns, node:fs, node:http, node:https, node:os, node:path, node:sqlite, node:url, node:worker_threads, node:zlib

properties.name: suds:embedded-sqlite
properties.value: node:sqlite embeds SQLite; its version is the Node release's own (node -p process.versions.sqlite)

components.name: node
components.description: Base image of the Dockerfile (the container deployment only). Pinned to a minor line by tag, not by digest: a rebuild takes that line's newest patch release.

components.name: suds-server
components.description: The office server: Node.js built-ins only. Also bundled into the browser kernel.

properties.name: suds:tree-method
properties.value: SHA-256 of the sorted lines "<sha256>  <path>\n" for every tracked file under server/ (the last line of: git ls-files -z server | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum)

components.name: suds-web-app
components.description: The web app (vanilla ES modules, no build step), served by the office server and published as SUDS on this device. The files listed individually are included in this tree too.

properties.name: suds:tree-method
properties.value: SHA-256 of the sorted lines "<sha256>  <path>\n" for every tracked file under public/ (the last line of: git ls-files -z public | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum)

components.name: suds-scripts
components.description: Operator and maintainer scripts (backup, key rotation, recovery drill, evidence verification, release checks, build) and the browser test suite (scripts/ui/). The Dockerfile copies this directory.

properties.name: suds:tree-method
properties.value: SHA-256 of the sorted lines "<sha256>  <path>\n" for every tracked file under scripts/ (the last line of: git ls-files -z scripts | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum)

components.name: public/local/kernel.js
components.description: The browser kernel: local/ and server/ bundled by esbuild (scripts/build-local.js, scripts/kernel-build-options.js), with the npm packages listed as bundled in it. Committed; CI fails if it differs from a fresh build.

components.name: public/local/kernel.js.gz
components.description: gzip (level 9) copy of kernel.js, served with Content-Encoding.

components.name: public/local/kernel.js.br
components.description: Brotli (quality 11) copy of kernel.js, served with Content-Encoding.

components.name: public/local/sql-wasm.wasm
components.description: Copied unchanged from the sql.js package (dist/sql-wasm.wasm) by scripts/build-local.js; SQLite compiled to WebAssembly.

components.name: public/local/sql-wasm.wasm.gz
components.description: gzip (level 9) copy of sql-wasm.wasm.

components.name: public/local/sql-wasm.wasm.br
components.description: Brotli (quality 11) copy of sql-wasm.wasm.

components.name: public/qr.js
components.description: QR code encoder written for SUDS (two-step verification enrolment), no third-party code: the secret never goes to a QR service.

components.name: server/schema-text.js
components.description: server/schema.sql as a JavaScript string for the browser kernel (scripts/gen-schema-text.js); CI fails if it drifts.
